scope: Rabat C8 product-locality taxonomy evidence only

decisions.reason: The Commune de Rabat explicitly identifies Habous Diour Jamaa as a quartier of Rabat in its official UNESCO heritage anniversary communication.

sources.title: Asmaa Rhlalou participe aux festivités du 10ème anniversaire de l’inscription de Rabat au patrimoine mondial de l’UNESCO

guardrails: Only explicit first-party quartier wording qualifies a candidate in this batch.
A heritage-site or address mention alone does not establish product-locality taxonomy.
No taxonomy status is changed by this evidence manifest.
No geometry or public map eligibility is changed.
